name: Establish Password Credential
summary: Establishes the password credential only after verified email ownership and complete profile data.

preconditions.expression: pending-identity-status == resolution-required and pending-identity-flow == password and email-ownership == verified and profile-completeness == complete and credential-proof == none

postconditions.expression: credential-proof == password-proved and durable-identity == creation-required and session-capability == identity-ceremony
